skill.name: box-automation
skill.description: Automate authorized Box cloud storage work through Rube MCP, including search, upload, download, folder management, sharing, collaborations, and metadata queries.
skill.summary: Run guided Box file, folder, sharing, and metadata workflows through Rube MCP.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown inline code around Box and Rube MCP tool names. One low-severity network finding is real because the setup uses an external MCP endpoint, and semantic review found high-impact Box download, sharing, and deletion capabilities.

remediation.issue: External MCP and OAuth trust boundary
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before adding Rube MCP or completing Box OAuth. Document requested Box scopes and data handled by the MCP provider.

remediation.issue: Sensitive Box data export and sharing workflows
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation with file names, IDs, recipients, roles, and sharing scope before downloads, zip exports, links, or collaboration changes.

remediation.issue: Destructive Box file and folder operations
remediation.suggestion: Require a final confirmation before delete or permanent remove actions. Prefer trash operations and show the target path and ID first.

remediation.issue: Static analyzer noise from Markdown tool names
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that backticked names are MCP tool identifiers and not local shell commands. Keep examples free of executable shell snippets.

content.value_statement: Box work can require repeated search, folder lookup, sharing, and metadata steps. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical workflows for authorized Box operations.
actual_capabilities: Search Box content by name, content, folder, file type, date, or metadata.
List Box folder contents and resolve file or folder IDs.
Upload files to selected Box folders and download files by ID.
Create, rename, move, copy, delete, and permanently remove folders.
Review and update file collaborations, roles, shared links, and locks.
List Box Sign requests, view request details, and cancel pending requests.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active authenticated Box connection.
Uses available Rube MCP schemas, so tool parameters can change over time.
Standard upload guidance does not cover files over 50MB.
Box permissions and enterprise settings can block sharing, deletion, or sign actions.

use_cases.title: Organize project files
use_cases.description: Find project folders, list contents, upload new files, and create folders with consistent names.

use_cases.title: Review access and sharing
use_cases.description: Inspect file collaborations, identify external users, and prepare role changes for approval.

use_cases.title: Search records by metadata
use_cases.description: Use Box metadata templates and folder filters to locate documents for reporting or review.

prompt_templates.title: Find a folder
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the Box folder named Project Atlas and list its first 20 items.

prompt_templates.title: Upload a file
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload the local proposal PDF to the Box folder named Client Reviews. Confirm the target folder before uploading.

prompt_templates.title: Search by metadata
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Box for quarterly contracts updated this month, group results by folder, and identify files missing required metadata.

prompt_templates.title: Audit collaborations
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit Box collaborations for the Legal folder, flag external users, and prepare least-privilege role changes for approval.

output_examples.input: Find the Client Reviews folder and summarize recent PDF files.
output_examples.output: The response lists matching folders, confirms the chosen folder ID, and summarizes recent PDF names, owners, and update dates.

output_examples.input: Review who can access the board deck file.
output_examples.output: The response names each collaborator, current role, invite status, and any suggested access changes for approval.

output_examples.input: Prepare to delete an outdated archive folder.
output_examples.output: The response verifies the folder path, warns about permanent removal, and asks for confirmation before any destructive action.

best_practices: Search current Rube MCP schemas before running Box tools.
Confirm file names, folder paths, IDs, and permissions before write actions.
Use pagination for large folder listings, searches, and sign request lists.
anti_patterns: Do not delete, share, or move Box content without explicit user confirmation.
Do not assume IDs from partial search results when several items have similar names.
Do not expose shared links or collaboration lists in untrusted conversations.

faq.question: Does this skill need a Box account?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires an authenticated Box connection through Rube MCP.

faq.question: Can it upload and download files?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents upload and download workflows using Box file and folder IDs.

faq.question: Can it manage shared access?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review collaborations and prepare role or sharing changes when permissions allow.

faq.question: Does it support metadata search?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Box metadata query guidance and parameter notes.

faq.question: Can it permanently delete Box content?
faq.answer: Yes, if the connected account has permission. Users should require confirmation before destructive actions.

faq.question: Why should tools be searched first?
faq.answer: Rube MCP tool schemas can change. Searching first helps use current parameter names and required fields.
